about: The core `plan_root_authorized` check. Each case runs the PCActn of the named vectors.json vector (which is valid in every other check) through the CORE verifier with the stated options and compares the plan_root_authorized check status, the overall allow and, on a deny, the reason. `$plan_root` stands for the vector's pcactn.plan.root. authorizedPlanRoots given (even empty): the check passes iff the root is listed, else FAILS. Omitted: it FAILS, unless insecureSkipPlanRootCheck is true, which reports not-enforced (allow is unaffected). The list wins over the skip flag. A deny's reason is `plan_root_authorized: <text>`. Every OTHER core vector (vectors.json) is run with insecureSkipPlanRootCheck true. Generated by scripts/gen-conformance-hardening.mjs; proved against the reference by src/hardening-vectors.test.ts.

plan_root_authorized.name: listed
plan_root_authorized.description: The plan root is the only listed root.

plan_root_authorized.name: listed-among-others
plan_root_authorized.description: The plan root is one of several listed roots.

plan_root_authorized.name: not-listed
plan_root_authorized.description: The plan root is not in the list.

expect.reason: plan_root_authorized: the plan root has not been authorized by the principal

plan_root_authorized.name: empty-list
plan_root_authorized.description: An empty list authorizes nothing (it is not the same as an omitted list).

expect.reason: plan_root_authorized: the plan root has not been authorized by the principal

plan_root_authorized.name: omitted
plan_root_authorized.description: No authorized plan configured and no opt-out: refused.

expect.reason: plan_root_authorized: no authorized plan is configured for this verifier (set authorizedPlanRoots, or the explicit insecureSkipPlanRootCheck)

plan_root_authorized.name: omitted-skip-false
plan_root_authorized.description: insecureSkipPlanRootCheck false is the same as omitted.

expect.reason: plan_root_authorized: no authorized plan is configured for this verifier (set authorizedPlanRoots, or the explicit insecureSkipPlanRootCheck)

plan_root_authorized.name: omitted-skip
plan_root_authorized.description: The explicit opt-out reports not-enforced and does not deny.

plan_root_authorized.name: list-wins-over-skip-listed
plan_root_authorized.description: A given list is enforced even when the opt-out is set (listed root passes).

plan_root_authorized.name: list-wins-over-skip-not-listed
plan_root_authorized.description: A given list is enforced even when the opt-out is set (unlisted root fails).

expect.reason: plan_root_authorized: the plan root has not been authorized by the principal
